g.text: fig 6 — instance normalisation is an affine map that collapses the drift

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: every look-back window has its own (μ, σ). x̃ = (x − μ)/σ sends that whole cloud onto one point, so the encoder only ever sees shape. (channel 4, which drifts in both level and scale)
